description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BasePassthroughConfig' that encapsulates configuration and utility methods for making and managing HTTP requests, especially in the context of large language model integrations. It includes abstract methods for request classification and URL construction, as well as concrete implementations for URL formatting, request signing, error handling, and response processing.

classes.name: BasePassthroughConfig
classes.description: An abstract base class for configuring and handling HTTP requests for language models, providing methods for URL formatting, request signing, error handling, and response logging.
